meta.title: Master QCS with two bids
gaps: The lowest-price vendor's visual highlight in the Master QCS grid
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: The lowest-price vendor's visual highlight in the Master QCS grid

steps.note: Open the prepared RFQ comparison screen as required for this case.
Reach the published event's Participants list to add the second bid.
Enter the second vendor's bid at 90, producing the expected lower total for the second vendor.
Verify that the added surrogate bid was accepted.
Return to the Master QCS comparison after both bids exist.
Assert that the comparison has exactly two real vendor columns.
Verify the original vendor's bid rate.
Verify the original vendor's expected total amount.
Verify the original vendor is ranked second.
Verify the second vendor's lower bid rate.
Verify the second vendor's expected total amount.
Verify the lower-priced second vendor is ranked first.
Assert that ranks follow the lowest bid amount.
